business_summary.text: NDR Auto Components Limited is an auto component manufacturer specializing in seat frames, seat covers, and other automotive parts. The company operates through its subsidiaries including Bharat Seats and NDR Hayashi, and is expanding its product portfolio to include ambient lighting, seatbelts, and other components.

timeline.summary: NDR Auto Components Limited held its Q1FY27 earnings conference call on August 11, 2026, reporting revenue of ₹221.45 Cr, EBITDA of ₹26.44 Cr, and PAT of ₹16.40 Cr. The company announced the commencement of operations at NDR Hayashi facility in Bangalore and the inauguration of NDR South plant in Anantapur, with SOP starting in Q2FY27. Bharat Seats revenue grew by 35% YoY, and management raised its target to ₹3,500 Cr by FY30.
